items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: In the same building I got up and I got against Dave. Me and Dave had it.

ctx.x: Yeah, I had my case right there with your good night. I'd take that one out and play nothing. You couldn't take it out? No. He'd take the time and he'd make you sit down there and he'd ask you questions. And now he'd ask you how many notes in music and how you divide the music. What are seven notes in music? In other words, four notes. You understand? You can make more than that. He'd ask you all them questions like that. Well, sometimes you wouldn't have your mind. He kept you on a snap journey to catch you…

back in town, Ruben, Ruben they called him. Ruben, Ruben can tell you. Well we had about nine pieces and Dave, well Dave Band was up there too playing. And so Dave, uh, Dave was telling me. So I'm gonna tell you man, I got up there, Mike I swear to Jesus Christ boy, there was there and Bigfoot Billy was with it. Stay down there, I'm trying to never man you sure be asking me that. So Mike, Mike seen Dave with Dave Band, Dave played a couple of them. Man he said no lie Mike, I'm not lying. Mike in California, Mike…
